en.topic_title: University of Hong Kong chief Zhang Xiang to step down in 2028 to focus on research
en.topic_summary:
The University of Hong Kong’s (HKU) President and Vice-Chancellor Zhang Xiang has said he will step down in 2028 and return to the laboratory to focus on research.



University of Hong Kong president and vice-chancellor Zhang Xiang. Photo: University of Hong Kong.



The 62-year-old Chinese-American mechanical engineer said in a letter to the university community that he had informed the governing HKU Council of his decision, so a successor could be found.
